Analysis.object: Both dimensions of motivational orientation were not significant in the prediction of EDE-Q factors. In the predction we should stress the importance of satisfaction with body shape and physical appearance, impression motivation, somatic anxiety and worry, threat perception and weight related coach pressure.

Need to further examine the impact of the psychological variables in eating disordered behaviors, since as this study showed some unexpected results. For example, impression motivation (which was related to an increased tendency for eating disordered behaviors) also tends to be associated with positive effects, particularly in the prevention of risk behaviors to health. The aalysis of these relationships can not only improve our understanding about the impact of psychological factors on eating disorders but also help in the prevention of this problems in sports contexts.
